diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 4.5 V, datasheet reading 5 V
diffs.evidence: The second reading gave only the 5 V nominal value as both limits. The SRD-05VDC-SL-C datasheet coil table (High sensitivity 'L', code 05) lists: Nominal Voltage 05 VDC, Nominal Current 71.4 mA, Resistance 70 Ω, Pull-In Voltage '75% Max.' (= 3.75 V), Drop-Out '10% Min.', Max-Allowable Voltage '120%' (= 6 V). The vendor module page (components101) gives 'Supply voltage – 3.75V to 6V'. The model's 4.5 V minimum is the 5 V -10% rail tolerance, inside the 3.75 V pull-in limit with margin (pull-in rises with coil temperature), so it is a valid, conservative minimum, not an error.

diffs.diff: maximum supply: part 5.5 V, datasheet reading 5 V
diffs.evidence: SRD-05VDC-SL-C datasheet coil table: 'Max-Allowable Voltage 120%' of 5 V nominal = 6 V; components101 4-channel relay module page: 'Supply voltage – 3.75V to 6V'. 5 V is only the nominal coil voltage; the model's 5.5 V maximum (5 V +10%) is within the 6 V absolute limit and is the correct conservative operating maximum.
